settings_logging_purpose: Choose what Lodestar writes to its logs. By default, logs contain no torrent details.
settings_logging_events_lead: What gets a line in the log.
settings_logging_events_required: Required: without it, a log can't explain itself.
settings_logging_events_opt_in: On only while its opt-in is on.
settings_logging_kind_url: Tracker and source URLs (passkeys always removed)
settings_logging_data_help: What a line may contain. A kind that's off is never written: torrents appear as references, everything else as [hidden].
settings_logging_kind_carried: Would appear in events you've turned on ({count}): {events}
settings_logging_kind_carried_none: None of the events you've turned on would carry it.
settings_logging_dialog_title: Write torrent details to the log?
settings_logging_dialog_what: {kinds} will be written to the log file and the live log for as long as you choose.
settings_logging_dialog_where: The console and docker logs stay without them.
settings_logging_dialog_console: The console gets them too, and Lodestar can't delete what docker logs or the journal keep.
settings_logging_dialog_ends: When the time runs out, they turn off again and the log records the switch.
settings_logging_optins: Logged only when you opt in
settings_logging_optins_help: Off in every preset, Full included. Each turns on for 1 hour or 24 hours at most, and only in the log file and the live log.
settings_logging_optin_peer_help: Which peer had which torrent: a peer's address next to a torrent.
settings_logging_optin_filters_help: Which rule, term, exception, pack or list changed, and how.
settings_logging_optin_peer_warning: Lodestar normally never keeps which peer had which torrent. For as long as you choose, the log file will record it: a list of people's addresses next to what they share.
settings_logging_optin_filters_warning: Lodestar normally keeps no record of filtering changes. For as long as you choose, the log file will record each change you make to rules, terms, exceptions and lists.
settings_logging_optin_where: It never goes to the console, the journal or the Windows Event Log, because Lodestar can't delete those.
settings_logging_never_secrets: Passwords, API keys, feed tokens, cookies, secrets and sealed values
settings_logging_never_secrets_why: No setting can turn these on: a log is easy to share by mistake. The setup token is printed at start only until setup is done.
settings_logging_never_sealed: Names and paths of quarantined, dropped or hash-listed items
settings_logging_never_sealed_why: They stay sealed: lines carry the rule and a reference only.
settings_logging_banner_filters: Filter change details are being logged
settings_logging_delete_title: Also delete log files that contain torrent details?
settings_logging_delete_body: Log files written while torrent details were on: {count} ({size}).
settings_logging_failed_on: Couldn't turn it on, so it stays off: {message}
settings_logging_unavailable: Logging's current state couldn't be read.
settings_logging_unread: The change was sent, but Lodestar's current logging state couldn't be read. Reload the page to see it.
settings_logging_events_temporary: A temporary level from the live log is on, so more events are recorded right now than this list shows.
settings_logging_state_unknown: Can't read what logging records now
settings_logging_console_lead: What the console and docker logs get.
settings_logging_file_lead: What the log files keep, and for how long.
settings_logging_console_title: Show torrent details in the console?
settings_logging_console_body: Whenever the log file gets torrent details, the console will get them too. Lodestar can't delete what docker logs or the journal keep.
settings_logging_console_ends: Private keeps them out of the console. You can switch back at any time.
settings_logging_preview_failed: The preview isn't available right now. Your settings still save.
